title: Bride
& Groom
meet.note: Our families met over filter coffee and a horoscope; we met properly over a very long argument about the best idli in Madurai. Two years, many temple walks and one Nichayathartham later, we are still arguing about idlis, and we would not change a thing. Thank you for every blessing along the way. We cannot wait to see you at the mandapam.

photos.alt: Karthik and Meenakshi walking hand in hand down a pillared temple corridor
Buying jasmine at the flower market
Filter coffee on the steps of an old Chettinad house
Sitting by the temple tank among lit diyas
Running along the beach at sunrise
Foreheads together under strings of jasmine and marigold
